title: Unlocking the catalytic potential of heterogeneous nonprecious metals for selective hydrogenation reactions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01005A, Review Article
Wanbing Gong, Jun Ma, Guangyu Chen, Yitao Dai, Ran Long, Huijun Zhao, Yujie Xiong
This review gives a critical analysis on the recent breakthroughs of nonprecious metal catalysts for selective hydrogenation reactions from the perspective of different catalytic hydrogenation systems and discusses their relationships.
